method.build_configuration: Release, temporary isolated native Mac fixture
method.data: Synthetic 5,000- or 15,000-track catalogue, one large playlist, ordinary silent local WAV; CloudKit mocked and no live NAS
method.interaction: After a four-second startup wait, 48 iterations select a library section and call player.next, with a requested 500 ms delay between iterations. Sections: Recently Added, Artists, Genres, Playlists, large playlist, Search.
method.timing: Synchronous updateLibrary, flushSave and combined selection/player.next elapsed calls, measured with Date; first seeding mutation and flush omitted. Command timing is not end-to-end display latency.
method.statistics: Values retained from the four measured-summary.json files only. Median is sorted[n//2]; p95 is sorted[min(n-1,int(n*0.95))].
method.instrument: Instruments SwiftUI template recorded Hitches and Time Profiler; SwiftUI view-body detail was unavailable.

limits: Candidate fixture was captured before final error wording, UI-only fixes and the CloudSync account-change/decode-error guard. Persistence preparation is unchanged; the documented CloudSync correctness change was reviewed and tested separately.
Raw hitch counts are not a controlled baseline/candidate comparison: trace/loop durations, mutation and flush counts, startup and window/compositor activity differ.
Synchronous command samples do not measure complete frame rendering or prove smooth navigation. Candidate traces still contain stalls up to 1,333.332416 ms.
Routine persistence is the measured fix. Cold profile activation, incoming remote merges and remaining navigation work need separate investigation.
One development Mac, synthetic data and local audio do not establish NAS/CloudKit, iPhone/iPad, Watch, TV or CarPlay acceptance, nor power-loss durability.

expected_differences: Temporary synchronous updateLibrary and flushSave timing probes
Final checks of account generation before each record, after asynchronous decode failure, and before deletions
Final internal injectable decoder closure, defaulting to the same detached ProfileCloudPreparation.decode worker
candidate_final_source_comparison.comparison_status: Fixture predates the final account-isolation correction; complete diff reviewed, no unexpected difference. Routine persistence timings do not execute CloudKit because this fixture has no cloud account.
